name: 60002 · Antioch, IL
findings: ZIP 60002 (Antioch) has 60 nonprofit organizations. 25 of them (42%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 19 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (27% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 60002 (Antioch) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 60002 (Antioch) list volunteering in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 32% of the typical level).
